blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spectral band synthesis is an important research topic in remote sensing. The Brazilian satellites CBERS-4, CBERS-4A, and AMAZONIA-1 provide high temporal resolution (1-3 days) visible and near-infrared (VNIR) imagery through the Wide-Field Imager (WFI), but lack short-wave infrared (SWIR) bands. Recent deep learning methods have shown promising results for spectral synthesis, but challenges remain for cross-satellite generalization and spectrally distant bands. This paper presents a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) with an attention-enhanced U-net generator and a multi-loss objective to synthesize Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR bands 11 (SWIR-1) and 12 (SWIR-2) from WFI VNIR inputs. Experiments used 4,125 patches for training and cross-validation and 1,026 unseen patches for testing, with hyperparameters optimized using a subset of the training data. On SWIR-1, the model achieved SSIM of 0.900, PSNR of 31.44 dB, and MAE of 0.019 in TOA reflectance. On SWIR-2, it achieved SSIM of 0.917, PSNR of 33.35 dB, and MAE of 0.015. Benchmarking was performed on the test dataset, with each model optimized separately prior to evaluation. SWIR-cGAN outperformed the baselines, particularly for SWIR-2. The ablation study identified the multi-loss as the main performance contributor, while the attention and residual modules provided additional improvements. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of synthesizing SWIR bands from WFI imagery. The SWIR-cGAN is available at https://github.com/marujore/swir-cgan.
blocks.zh: 光谱波段合成是遥感领域的一个重要研究课题. 巴西的CBERS-4号卫星、CBERS-4A号和AMAZONIA-1号卫星通过广域成像仪(WFI)提供高时间分辨率(1至3天)可见和近红外图像,但缺乏短波红外波波段。 最近的深层学习方法显示出光谱合成的可喜结果,但跨卫星通化和光谱相距波段仍存在挑战。 本文提出有条件的基因辅助网络(cGAN),并附有注意增强的U-net生成器和从WFI VNIR投入合成Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR波段11(SWIR-1)和12(SWIR-2)的多损失目标. 实验使用4,125个补丁用于培训和交叉验证,并使用1,026个隐形补丁用于测试,其中高参数的优化使用了培训数据的子集. 在SWIR-1上,该型号在TOA反射中实现了0.900的SSIM,31.44分贝的PSNR和0.019的MAE. 在SWIR-2上,它实现了0.917的SSIM,33.35分贝的PSNR和0.015的MAE. 在测试数据集上进行了基准制定,每个模型在评价前分别优化. SWIR-cGAN的表现超过了基线,特别是SWIR-2。 消减研究确定多亏是主要的业绩贡献者,而注意力和剩余模块则提供了进一步的改进。 我们的研究结果表明,从WFI图像合成SWIR波段是可行的。 SWIR-cGAN可在https://github.com/marujore/swir-cgan上查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The China-Brazil Earth Resources Satellite (CBERS) program ensures continuity of comparable data over time [ 1 ] . Since 1999, this program has evolved to the current operational CBERS-4 and CBERS-4A satellites. Additionally, AMAZONIA-1, launched in 2021, is the first satellite fully developed and operated in Brazil. These platforms carry multiple optical sensors, including the Wide-Field Imager (WFI). The WFI sensors acquire visible (RGB) and near-infrared (NIR) imagery (hereafter VNIR) at revisit intervals of 1–3 days but lack a short-wave infrared (SWIR) band, which is important for environmental applications such as burned-area detection.
blocks.zh: 中国-巴西地球资源卫星(CBERS)方案确保可比数据在一段时间内的连续性[1]。 自1999年以来,该方案已发展成为目前运行的CBERS-4和CBERS-4A卫星. 此外,2021年发射的AMAZONIA-1号卫星是巴西第一颗全面开发和运行的卫星。 这些平台搭载多个光学传感器,包括广域成像仪(WFI). WFI传感器在1至3天的重访间隔中获得可见(RGB)和近红外(NIR)图像(下称VNIR),但缺乏短波红外波波段(SWIR),这对烧伤区域探测等环境应用十分重要.

blocks.en: Approaches based on conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGANs) [ 2 ] have been applied to reconstruct spectral bands from limited inputs. Rodríguez et al. [ 3 ] evaluated U-net and ResNet generators with a PatchGAN [ 4 ] discriminator to synthesize Sentinel-2/MSI bands from RGB channels. While their framework relied on visible wavelengths, incorporating NIR would be a practical choice, as it is readily available on most orbital sensors. Similarly, Illarionova et al. [ 5 ] employed cGANs to predict NIR from WorldView-2 RGB images. They emphasized that NIR synthesis is constrained by the spectral information available in the visible bands. Green roofs and vegetation, for instance, may exhibit similar RGB profiles yet distinct NIR responses, highlighting the importance of spatial context, shape, and texture in spectral inference [ 5 ] . Bridging more spectrally distant wavelengths, Hu et al. [ 6 ] used GANs for synthetic aperture radar (SAR)-to-optical translation, aiming to support the mapping of burned areas. Although optical outputs avoid radar speckle, cross-domain translation remains difficult due to heterogeneous landscapes, class imbalance, and adversarial training instability. These studies demonstrate both the potential of GANs for spectral band synthesis and the inherent challenges of this generation.
blocks.zh: 以有条件的Generative Adversarial Networks(cGANs)[2]为基础的方法已经应用于利用有限的输入重建光谱带. 罗德里格斯等人著. [3] 使用一个PatchGAN[4] 歧视器来评价U-net和ResNet发电机,以合成来自RGB频道的Sentinel-2/MSI频段. 虽然其框架依赖于可见的波长,但纳入国家清单报告将是一个实际的选择,因为大多数轨道传感器都很容易得到。 与此类似,Illarionova等人也曾提出过意见。 [5]使用cGANs预测国家清单报告 从WorldView-2 RGB图像。 他们强调,国家清单报告的综合工作受到可见波段现有光谱信息的制约。 例如,绿色屋顶和植被可能显示类似的RGB概况,但国家清单报告的答复不同,突出了空间背景、形状和纹理在光谱推断中的重要性[5]。 Hu等人,《缩小光谱较远的波长》。 [6] 使用GANs进行合成孔径雷达(SAR)到光学的翻译,旨在支持对燃烧地区的测绘. 虽然光学输出避免了雷达光谱,但由于地貌不同、班级不平衡和对抗性训练不稳定,跨域翻译仍然很困难。 这些研究显示了GANs在光谱波段合成方面的潜力以及这一代人的固有挑战.

blocks.en: Motivated by such works, we introduce SWIR-cGAN for synthesizing SWIR bands using VNIR bands from WFI. Our framework addresses spectral ambiguity, spatial degradation, and GAN instability through targeted design choices. Adding NIR to RGB bands provides richer information for predicting SWIR behavior. Attention gates and residual connections in the U-net generator help maintain fine textures and context, while the PatchGAN discriminator captures local details. A composite multi-loss formulation promotes training stability, preserves high-frequency details, and mitigates mode collapse when synthesizing SWIR bands (B11 and B12) from MSI.
blocks.zh: 以这些作品为动力,我们引入了SWIR-cGAN,用于利用来自WFI的VNIR波段合成SWIR波段. 我们的框架通过有针对性的设计选择,解决光谱模糊、空间退化和GAN不稳定等问题。 将国家清单报告添加到RGB波段中,为预测SWIR行为提供了更丰富的信息. U-net生成器中的注意门和剩余连接有助于保持精细的纹理和上下文,而PatchGAN歧视者则捕捉本地细节. 复合多损失配方可促进训练稳定性,保存高频细节,并在合成MSI的SWIR波段(B11和B12)时减轻模式崩溃.

blocks.en: The present method could support Brazil’s environmental monitoring programs, such as the Real-Time Deforestation Detection System (Deter), which issues daily deforestation and forest degradation alerts in the Amazon and Cerrado biomes through image analysis by experts. Deter recently transitioned from using 500 m MODIS images to 55 m (CBERS-4A) and 64 m (CBERS-4 and AMAZONIA-1) WFI imagery [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前的方法可以支持巴西的环境监测方案,例如实时砍伐森林探测系统(Deter),该系统通过专家的图像分析发布亚马逊和塞拉多生物群落的每日砍伐森林和森林退化警报。 威慑最近从使用500米MODIS图像过渡到55米(CBERS-4A)和64米(CBERS-4和AMAZONIA-1) WFI图像[7].

blocks.en: II Dataset
blocks.zh: 二. 数据集

blocks.en: The WFI images were converted to top-of-atmosphere (TOA) reflectance, while the Sentinel-2/MSI bands (Level-1C) were resampled to the WFI spatial resolution (55 m or 64 m) with bilinear interpolation. Using the AROSICS library [ 8 ] , the MSI NIR band (B8) was coregistered with the WFI NIR reference, and its estimated displacement was applied to the SWIR bands. This improved spatial source–target correspondence, reducing misalignment effects and noises on band synthesis. Therefore, each spatiotemporal pair was acquired on the same day. The training and validation dataset comprises 4,125 pairs of 128 × 128 128\times 128 -pixel patches from 10 distinct WFI scenes (Level-4), matching 65 distinct MSI tiles across nine dates in 2024. The test dataset comprises 1,026 patches with no spatial or temporal overlap with the training and validation subsets. Figure 1 illustrates the spatial distribution of the patches, with most located in the Brazilian Cerrado biome.
blocks.zh: WFI图像被转换为顶层反射(TOA),而Sentinel-2/MSI波段(Level-1C)被重印为WFI空间分辨率(55米或64米),并带有双线插值. 利用AROSICS库[8],MSI国家清单报告频段(B8)与WFI国家清单报告参考资料共同登记,估计的流离失所情况适用于SWIR频段。 这种改进的空间源-目标对应,减少了波段合成上的错位效应和噪声. 因此,每一对spatiotecal配对都是在同一天获得的. 培训和验证数据集由4,125对128×128128\times128-像素补丁组成,来自10个不同的WFI场景(Level-4),与2024年9个日期的65个不同的MSI瓷砖相匹配. 测试数据集包含1,026个补丁,与培训和验证子集没有空间或时间重叠. 图1显示了补丁的空间分布,大多数位于巴西Cerrado生物群落.

The open dataset has 5,151 paired WFI–MSI patches acquired on the same day: 1,742 from CBERS-4A (1,361 train/val, 381 test), 1,796 from CBERS-4 (1,446 train/val, 350 test), and 1,613 from AMAZONIA-1 (1,318 train/val, 295 test).

blocks.en: III Methods
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 三-A 网络结构

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the SWIR-cGAN framework. The generator is based on a U-net architecture with attention gates and residual connections to improve feature propagation and focus on spatially relevant regions. It is trained with a multi-loss objective, where each loss component aims to address a distinct aspect of the synthesis problem. The implementation uses PyTorch 2.7.1 [ 9 ] with CUDA 11.8 support.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了SWIR-cGAN框架。 发电机以U网结构为基础,有注意门和剩余连接,以改善特性传播,并注重空间相关区域。 它的培训具有多重损失目标,每一损失部分都旨在解决综合问题的一个不同方面。 实施时使用PyTorch 2.7.1 [9],并获得CUDA 11.8的支持.

blocks.en: The L 1 L_{1} loss enforces pixel-wise correspondence while reducing the oversmoothing often associated with L 2 L_{2} -based optimization. The Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) loss promotes structural consistency by preserving local luminance, contrast, and structural patterns. The gradient loss preserves high-frequency spatial transitions, minimizing blurred boundaries between surface targets. The perceptual loss, computed with a pre-trained VGG-16 network, promotes feature-space similarity to improve textural patterns. Finally, the adversarial loss, guided by a PatchGAN discriminator, promotes distribution alignment with real SWIR bands, improving realism.
blocks.zh: L1 LQQ1} 丢失执行像素偏移的通信, 同时减少与 L2 LQQ2 经常相关的过度流畅 - 基于优化。 结构相似度指数(SSIM)损失通过保持局部亮度、对比度和结构模式促进结构一致性。 梯度损失保持了高频空间过渡,将表面目标之间的模糊界限降到最低. 用预先训练的VGG-16网络计算出来的知觉损失,促进特征-空间相似性,以改善纹理模式。 最后,在PatchGAN歧视者的指导下,对抗性损失促进了与真正的SWIR波段的分布协调,提高了现实性。

blocks.en: III-A 1 Generator
blocks.zh: 发电机

Let x ∈ ℝ 4 × H × W x\in\mathbb{R}^{4\times H\times W} denote the input tensor (VNIR patches). To mitigate edge artifacts, symmetric reflection padding of size p = 16 p=16 is applied: x pad = ReflectPad ​ ( x , p ) x_{\text{pad}}=\text{ReflectPad}(x,p) (1)

blocks.en: The encoder consists of four downsampling stages. Each stage applies reflection padding ( p = 1 p=1 ) to minimize boundary artifacts, followed by a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution with stride s = 2 s=2 , instance normalization (IN) (except in the first stage) to accelerate convergence, and LeakyReLU (LReLU) activation ( α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 ). This operation reduces the spatial resolution by a factor of two while increasing the number of feature channels (c) from 4 4 to 1024 1024 in the bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 编码器由四个下取样阶段组成. 每个阶段应用反射垫(p = 1 p = 1)将边界文物最小化,然后是3×3 3 3 3 3 3 3 的曲折,与阶梯 S = 2 s = 2,例正常化(IN)(第一阶段除外)以加速趋同,而LeakyReLU(LReLU)激活(α = 0.2\alpha = 0.2). 这一操作将空间分辨率减少2倍,同时将瓶颈中的特征通道(c)从4个4个增加到1024个1024个。

blocks.en: Each stage is followed by a residual block (ResBlock) composed of two convolutional layers ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution with stride 1 1 ), each followed by instance normalization, with a ReLU activation after the first convolution and after the residual addition. The block output is added to the input via an identity skip connection: Res ​ ( f ) = ReLU ​ ( f + IN ​ ( W 2 ∗ ReLU ​ ( IN ​ ( W 1 ∗ f ) ) ) ) \text{Res}(f)=\text{ReLU}\left(f+\text{IN}(W_{2}*\text{ReLU}(\text{IN}(W_{1}*f)))\right) (2) where ∗ * denotes convolution. This structure facilitates gradient flow and stabilizes training. The number of feature channels increases progressively as 4 → 128 → 256 → 512 → 1024 4\rightarrow 128\rightarrow 256\rightarrow 512\rightarrow 1024 .
blocks.zh: 每个阶段之后都有一个由两个转录层组成的残块(ResBlock)(3×3 3\times 3 concurvation with stride 1 1),每个阶段之后是实例正常化,在第一次转录后和剩余加成后进行ReLU激活. 块输出通过身份跳过连接加入输入 : Res (f) = ReLU (f + IN (W 2 → ReLU (IN (W 1 → f)))\text{Res}(f)\text{左(f+\text{IN})(W_{2}*\text{ReLU}(\text{IN}(W_{1}*f)))\right) (2) 其中 *表示演化. 这种结构有利于梯度流动和稳定训练。 特色频道的数量逐渐增加,以4~128~256~512~1024~128~256~1024.

blocks.en: Each stage performs nearest-neighbor upsampling (scale factor 2 2 ), with value preservation, followed by an attention gate that weights the corresponding encoder features to emphasize spatially relevant regions. The attended skip features are then concatenated with the upsampled features and processed by a convolutional block with reflection padding, instance normalization, and ReLU activation, followed by a residual block. The number of feature channels decreases from 1024 1024 to 128 128 . Dropout is then applied in the two deepest decoding layers to regularize the model and mitigate overfitting.
blocks.zh: 每个阶段都进行近邻抽样(尺度因子2 2 ),并保留价值,然后有一个注意门,对相应的编码器特征进行加权,以强调空间相关区域。 被附着的跳跃特性随后与被提升的特性相配合,并由一个带有反射垫,例正常化,和ReLU激活的旋动块处理,然后是剩余块. 特色频道数量从1024个1024个减少到128个128个. 然后在两个最深层的解码层中应用退学,使模型规范化,减轻过度适应.

blocks.en: The final layer (synthesized SWIR band) applies a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to map 128 128 feature channels to a single output band (target SWIR band), followed by a sigmoid activation. The initial reflection padding ( p = 16 p=16 ) is removed from the output, restoring the original spatial resolution and ensuring consistency with the input patch.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Discriminator
blocks.zh: III-A 2 歧视者

blocks.en: The discriminator is a fully convolutional PatchGAN that operates on the concatenated image pair [ x , y ] ∈ ℝ 5 × H × W [x,y]\in\mathbb{R}^{5\times H\times W} , combining the 4-band input x x and the target band y y . It is trained with a binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss to distinguish real pairs from generated ones. Label smoothing is applied, using targets of 0.9 0.9 for real samples and 0 for synthesized samples to stabilize adversarial training. The network consists of a sequence of convolutional layers with kernel size 4 × 4 4\times 4 , using stride s = 2 s=2 in the initial layers and s = 1 s=1 in the deeper layer, followed by instance normalization (except in the first layer) and LeakyReLU activation ( α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 ). The number of feature channels increases progressively from 64 64 to 128 128 , 256 256 , and 512 512 . The network outputs a patch-wise map, where each element indicates the probability of a real patch, guiding the generator toward realistic SWIR synthesis.
blocks.zh: 歧义者是一个完全曲折的PatchGAN,在缩合图像对 [x, y] 上运行 \ R 5 × H × W [x, y]\ in\ mathbb{ R\\\ 5\ 时 H\times W},结合4波段输入xx和目标带y y. 它被训练成二进制的横切(BCE)损耗,以区分真对和生成的对. 采用标签平滑法,将0.9 0.9的目标用于真实样品,0用于合成样品,以稳定对抗性训练。 网络由内核大小4×4 4 4\times 4的演化层序列组成,在初始层使用阶梯s=2 s=2 s=2 s=1 s=1 s=1 s 更深层,之后是实例正常化(第一层除外)和LeakyReLU激活(α=0.2\alpha=0.2). 特色频道的数量从64个64个逐步增加到128个128个,256个256个,512个512个。 网络输出一个修补图,每个元素都表示一个真正的修补的概率,引导生成器向现实的SWIR合成方向发展.

blocks.en: III-B Experiment
blocks.zh: 三-B实验

blocks.en: All processing was conducted in the Brazil Data Cube Lab (BDC-Lab), a geospatial data science environment hosted on the infrastructure of Brazil’s National Institute for Space Research (INPE) that enables virtual machine (VM) instantiation with customizable configurations [ 10 ] . For this experiment, a VM was configured with two NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs (16 GB each) and up to 232 GB of system RAM.
blocks.zh: 所有处理均在巴西数据立方实验室(BDC-Lab)进行,该实验室是一个地理空间数据科学环境,设在巴西国家空间研究所(INPE)的基础设施上,能够以可定制的配置进行虚拟机器即时处理[10]。 对于这个实验,一个VM被配置了两个NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU(每个16 GB)和最多232 GB的系统RAM.

blocks.en: A random 20 % 20\% subset of the training dataset was used for hyperparameter tuning using Optuna [ 11 ] . Hyperparameters were optimized independently for each SWIR band to account for its spectral characteristics, using 50 50 trials of 25 25 epochs each and a batch size of 16 16 . Our cGAN uses a five-component loss objective with individually tuned weights, optimized learning rates (generator and discriminator), and dropout.
blocks.zh: 使用Optuna [11] 进行超参数调试时,随机使用了培训数据集的20% 20QQ子集。 对每个SWIR波段的超参数进行了独立优化,以反映其光谱特性,使用50个试验,每个试验25个25个时段,批量尺寸16个16。 我们的cGAN使用一个五元损失目标,其中个别调整权重,优化学习率(遗传者和歧视者),以及辍学。

blocks.en: Using the optimized hyperparameters, five-fold cross-validation was performed on the remaining training data with a fixed random seed of 42 42 . Each fold used disjoint training and validation partitions, ensuring every sample was evaluated exactly once. On-the-fly data augmentation was performed using Albumentations [ 12 ] , including horizontal and vertical flips and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} rotations, each applied with a probability of 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 利用优化的超参数,对剩余的训练数据进行了5倍的交叉验证,固定随机种子42 42 . 每个折叠都使用了脱节培训和验证分区,确保每个样本都得到一次准确评价。 飞行上的数据增强是使用专辑[12]进行的,包括水平和垂直翻转以及90 ∘ 90^{\circ}旋转,每次应用的概率为0.5 0.5.

blocks.en: To benchmark the proposed method, we compare it against three architectures representing distinct design paradigms: U-net [ 13 ] , a purely convolutional baseline; ESRGAN [ 14 ] , a state-of-the-art super-resolution architecture adapted for spectral synthesis with 12 12 RRDB blocks, 32 32 feature channels, and 16 16 growth channels, incorporating relativistic adversarial learning; and ViT-U-net, which replaces the convolutional bottleneck with a Vision Transformer (ViT) to capture long-range dependencies [ 15 ] , [ 16 ] , with a PatchGAN discriminator.
blocks.zh: 为了确定拟议方法的基准,我们把它与代表不同设计范式的三种建筑进行比较:U-net [13],一个纯粹的演化基线;ESRGAN [14],一个适用于光谱合成的最先进的超分辨率建筑,有12个RRDB区块,32个特征通道,16个生长渠道,包含相对论对抗性学习;和ViT-U-net,它用一个视觉变形器(ViT)取代了演化瓶颈,以捕捉远距离依赖性[15],[16],有一个PatchGAN歧论者.

blocks.en: All models underwent the Optuna hyperparameter optimization, with search spaces tailored to each architecture. For U-net, we optimized learning rate and dropout. For ESRGAN, we optimized L1, perceptual, and GAN loss weights, learning rates, dropout, and warmup schedule. For ViT-U-net, we optimized L1 and GAN losses, learning rates, and dropout.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都经过了Optuna超参数优化,每个架构都有专门的搜索空间。 对于U网,我们优化了学习率和辍学率. 对于ESRGAN,我们优化了L1,知觉,GAN减重,学习率,退学率,热身表. 对于ViT-U-net,我们优化了L1和GAN的损失,学习率和辍学率.

blocks.en: Each model was trained on 95 % 95\% of the data, reserving 5 % 5\% for early stopping and learning-rate scheduling. Training was performed under identical conditions, including fixed random seeds, deterministic CUDA operations, and data splits, ensuring that performance differences reflect architectural choices rather than training variability. Generalization was evaluated on a test dataset comprising 1,026 unseen WFI–MSI patches.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都接受了95%95%数据的培训,为早期停课和学习率安排预留5%5%的数据。 培训是在相同条件下进行的,包括固定随机种子、确定性CUDA操作和数据分割,确保性能差异反映建筑选择,而不是培训的可变性。 在一个包含1,026个未见WFI-MSI补丁的测试数据集上对通用性进行了评价.

blocks.en: The ablation study then assessed the contributions of architectural components and loss functions in SWIR-cGAN under the same protocol. Results were evaluated using SSIM, Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Pearson correlation, Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test.
blocks.zh: 之后,开发研究根据同一协议评估了SWIR-cGAN建筑部件和损失功能的贡献。 利用SSIM,峰信号对噪比(PSNR),皮尔逊相关,平均绝对误差(MAE)和威尔科森签名排名测试对结果进行了评价.

blocks.en: IV Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 四. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: IV-A Hyperparameter optimization
blocks.zh: IV-A 超参数优化

blocks.en: The optimized hyperparameters in Table I reveal distinct training strategies for the SWIR-1 and SWIR-2 bands, reflecting differences in spectral complexity and synthesis difficulty.
blocks.zh: 表一中优化的超参数显示SWIR-1和SWIR-2波段不同的培训策略,反映了光谱复杂度和合成难度的差异.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Optimized hyperparameters for the SWIR-cGAN model.
blocks.zh: 表格 I: SWIR-cGAN模型的优化超参数.

blocks.en: SWIR-1 is driven primarily by structural objectives, with SSIM and gradient losses dominating over pixel-wise and adversarial terms, indicating a stronger emphasis on spatial consistency. SWIR-2 adopts a more balanced multi-objective setup, with increased contributions from L1, perceptual, adversarial, and gradient losses, together with stronger regularization, suggesting a more complex and less directly recoverable mapping. Both cases use a higher generator learning rate than the discriminator, supporting stable adversarial optimization.
blocks.zh: SWIR-1主要由结构目标驱动,SSIM和梯度损失在像素和对抗性术语中占主导地位,这表明更加强调空间一致性。 SWIR-2采用了更加平衡的多目标设置,增加了L1、感知性、对抗性和梯度性损失的贡献,同时加强了规范化,表明绘制更复杂、可直接收回的地图。 两案均采用比歧视者更高的发电机学习率,支持稳定的对抗优化.

blocks.en: IV-B Cross-validation
blocks.zh: 四-B 交叉验证

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the validation performance for the synthesized SWIR bands over the five cross-validation folds.
blocks.zh: 表二总结了合成的SWIR波段在五个交叉验证折叠上的验证性能.

blocks.en: TABLE II: Cross-validation performance for SWIR synthesis. Values are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over folds.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:SWIR合成的交叉验证性能. 数值报告为平均±\pm 标准差大于折叠值。

blocks.en: SWIR-1 centered at 1,610 nm achieved an SSIM of 0.900 0.900 , PSNR of 31.44 31.44 dB, and MAE of 0.019 0.019 , indicating moderate synthesis quality, corresponding to average absolute errors of approximately 1.9 % 1.9\% in TOA reflectance (a dimensionless quantity). The best models were obtained after approximately 81 training epochs, with generator and discriminator losses decreasing from 11.5 11.5 to 7.8 7.8 and from 0.67 0.67 to 0.33 0.33 , respectively.
blocks.zh: SWIR-1以1,610纳米为中心,实现了0.900 0.900的SSIM,PSNR为31.44 31.44 dB,MAE为0.019 0.019,表示中度合成质量,相当于TOA反射中约1.9%1.9\%的平均绝对误差(无维数). 最佳模式是在大约81个培训时代之后获得的,发电机和歧视器的损失分别从11.5个11.5个降至7.8个7.8个,从0.67 0.67个降至0.33 0.33个。

blocks.en: SWIR-2 achieved superior performance across all metrics (SSIM: 0.917 0.917 ; PSNR: 33.35 33.35 dB; MAE: 0.015 0.015 ) after convergence at around 80 epochs, with generator loss decreasing from 12.1 12.1 to 8.64 8.64 and discriminator loss from 0.67 0.67 to 0.38 0.38 . Despite outperforming SWIR-1 in synthesis metrics, the higher generator loss suggests greater difficulty in modeling fine spectral details. Low cross-fold variance indicates systematic rather than data-driven differences.
blocks.zh: SWIR-2在大约80个纪元的交汇后,在所有度量衡上取得了优异的性能(SSIM:0.917 0.917;PSNR:33.35 33.35 dB;MAE:0.015 0.015),发电机损失从12.112降至8.64 8.64,歧视者损失从0.67 0.67降至0.38 0.38. 尽管SWIR-1在合成度量衡方面表现优于此,但较高的发生器损失表明在模拟精细的光谱细节方面有更大的困难. 低跨倍差异表明系统差异而不是数据驱动的差异。

blocks.en: These results show a decoupling between adversarial and synthesis metrics: SWIR-1 has lower generator loss but reduced synthesis accuracy, while SWIR-2 shows the opposite pattern. This may reflects a trade-off between realism and structural fidelity that varies across both spectral bands. Despite these dynamics, stable cross-fold performance validates the SWIR-cGAN for Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR synthesis from WFI VNIR inputs.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明对抗力和合成度量衡之间的脱钩:SWIR-1的发生器损失较低,但合成精度降低,而SWIR-2则显示出相反的规律. 这可能反映现实主义和结构忠贞性之间的权衡,这两个光谱带各不相同。 尽管有这些动态,稳定的交叉性能验证了来自WFI VNIR投入的SWIR-cGAN用于Sentinel-2/MSI SWIR合成.

blocks.en: IV-C Baselines
blocks.zh: 四-C 基线

blocks.en: Table III compares SWIR-cGAN with other methods. Across both bands, SWIR-cGAN achieves the best performance, with the highest SSIM, PSNR, and Pearson correlation, and the lowest MAE. The performance gap over baselines is more pronounced for SWIR-2, suggesting better handling of its higher spectral complexity. Among baselines, ESRGAN performs fairly but falls short in correlation and error metrics (Pearson: 0.83 0.83 for ESRGAN vs. 0.87 0.87 for SWIR-cGAN).
blocks.zh: 表三比较了SWIR-cGAN与其他方法. 在整个两个乐队中,SWIR-cGAN都取得了最好的表现,最高的SSIM,PSNR,和皮尔逊相关,最低的MAE. 对SWIR-2来说,基线上的性能差距更为明显,表明能够更好地处理其较高的光谱复杂性。 在基线中,ESRGAN的性能相当好,但在相关性和误差度量方面却不足(Pearson:ESRGAN0.83 0.83,SWIR-cGAN0.87)。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Benchmark comparison. Values are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over the test set.
blocks.zh: 表三:基准比较。 数值报告为平均±\pm 标准比测试集差。

blocks.en: U-net and ViT-U-net yield lower SSIM ( 0.81 0.81 and 0.82 0.82 , respectively) and higher MAE ( 0.04 0.04 and 0.05 0.05 ). ViT-U-net does not reliably outperform U-net; for SWIR-2, U-net even surpasses it (SSIM: 0.82 0.82 vs. 0.81 0.81 ). This suggests that convolutional inductive biases are more suitable than global attention for this task, as transformers may dilute local spectral correlations. ViT-U-net might also demand more training data.
blocks.zh: U-net和ViT-U-net产生较低的SSIM(分别为0.81 0.81和0.82 0.82)和较高的MAE(0.04 0.04和0.05 0.05)。 ViT-U-net不能可靠地超越U-net;对于SWIR-2,U-net甚至超过了它(SSIM:0.82 0.82 vs.0.81 0.81 0.81). 这表明,与全球关注相比,革命性诱导偏差更适合完成这项任务,因为变压器可能会淡化局部光谱相关性. ViT-U-net也可能需要更多的培训数据。

blocks.en: All methods present high standard deviations for SWIR-1 (SSIM: 0.09 0.09 to 0.14 0.14 ; PSNR: 3.7 3.7 to 5.0 5.0 dB) and SWIR-2 (SSIM: 0.10 0.10 to 0.14 0.14 ; PSNR: 4.1 4.1 to 4.5 4.5 dB), reflecting some synthesis difficulty and variability, possibly related to differences between CBERS-4, CBERS-4A, and AMAZONIA-1 WFI radiometry and land-cover types. SWIR-cGAN, however, offers the best trade-off between performance and stability.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都对SWIR-1(SSIM:0.09 0.09至0.14 0.14;PSNR:3.7至5.0 5.0 dB)和SWIR-2(SSIM:0.10 0.10至0.14 0.14;PSNR:4.1至4.5 dB)提出了高标准偏差,反映了一些合成难度和可变性,可能与CBERS-4,CBERS-4A,AMAZONIA-1 WFI辐射测量和土地覆盖类型之间的差异有关. 然而,SWIR-cGAN在性能和稳定性之间提供了最好的权衡。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows synthesized SWIR bands for a patch with vegetation and fire-affected regions. Figure 3 a highlights lower errors for SWIR-cGAN, mainly over burned areas. Figure 3 b shows a small region with high errors related to an active fire.
blocks.zh: 图3显示合成了SWIR带,用于覆盖植被和受火灾影响的区域。 图3 a突出显示SWIR-cGAN较低的误差,主要是超过燃烧区域。 图3b显示一个小区域,存在与主动火灾有关的高误差。

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Examples of image patches containing vegetation and burned areas (represented by dark tones at the center of the false-color composites). (a) Predicted SWIR-1 band; (b) Predicted SWIR-2 band. There is an active fire (black circle) in the southern portion with higher errors in SWIR-2 band.
blocks.zh: 费格。 3:包含植被和烧焦区域的图像补丁实例(以假彩色复合材料中心的暗色色调为代表). (a) 预估的SWIR-1波段;(b) 预估的SWIR-2波段。 南方部分出现主动火(黑圆),SWIR-2波段错误较高.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation study
blocks.zh: IV-D 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table IV presents the contribution of each component to SWIR synthesis across target bands. The full model achieves the best performance for both SWIR-1 and SWIR-2. For SWIR-1, removing any component significantly degrades SSIM and PSNR, with most effects being highly significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). For SWIR-2, the multi-loss and attention mechanism show the strongest impact ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 for SSIM), while reflection padding and residual blocks have less influence.
blocks.zh: 表四列出每个组成部分对各目标段的SWIR综合的贡献。 完整的模式为SWIR-1和SWIR-2都实现了最佳性能. 就SWIR-1而言,去除任何组件都会显著降解SSIM和PSNR,其影响最大(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 对SWIR-2来说,多重损失和注意机制显示出最强的影响(SSIM为 < 0.001 p < 0.001),而反射垫板和残块的影响较小。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Ablation study results. Values are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation. Significance levels indicate statistical differences with respect to the Full model (one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test).
blocks.zh: 表格 四:读取研究成果. 数值报告为平均值±\pm标准差. 意义水平表明与Full模型(单侧Wilcoxon签名排名测试)相关的统计差异.

blocks.en: Among the evaluated components, the multi-loss has the largest contribution to synthesis quality, as its removal decreases SSIM by 0.016 0.016 ( 1.8 % 1.8\% ) and PSNR by 1.35 1.35 dB ( 4.6 % 4.6\% ) for SWIR-1, with smaller but systematic reductions observed for SWIR-2 (SSIM: − 0.010 -0.010 ; PSNR: − 0.540 -0.540 dB). At α < 0.001 \alpha<0.001 , the multi-loss is the only component showing significant effects on SSIM and PSNR in both SWIR bands.
blocks.zh: 在评估的成分中,多损失对合成质量的贡献最大,因为SWIR-1的去除量减少了SSIM 0.016 0.016 (1.8 % 1.8 %),PSNR减少了1.35 dB (4.6% 4.6 %),SWIR-2观察到的减少量较小但系统化(SSIM:−0.010 - 0.010;PSNR:−0.540 - 0.540 dB)。 在α < 0.001\alpha < 0.001 > 时,多损失是唯一在SWIR波段对SSIM和PSNR有重大影响的组件。

blocks.en: Attention and residual mechanisms offer more modest improvements. Removing attention causes slight performance degradation, indicating its role in feature refinement rather than core synthesis. Residual connections have a larger impact on SWIR-1 (SSIM: − 0.004 -0.004 , PSNR: − 0.360 -0.360 dB) than SWIR-2 (SSIM: − 0.001 -0.001 ; PSNR: − 0.100 -0.100 dB). Reflection padding has the least impact on quality among the evaluated components.
blocks.zh: 注意和留守机制的改进幅度较小。 消除注意力会导致轻微性能退化,表明其在特征改进而不是核心合成中的作用。 残余连接对SWIR-1(SSIM:− 0.004-0.04,PSNR:− 0.360-0.360 dB)的影响大于SWIR-2(SSIM:− 0.001-0.01;PSNR:− 0.100-0.100 dB). 反思对评价组成部分的质量影响最小。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This letter demonstrates the feasibility of synthesizing SWIR bands from VNIR data using SWIR-cGAN. The results show that synthesis performance is band-dependent, with different spectral targets benefiting from distinct trade-offs among structural, perceptual, and adversarial objectives. Ablation experiments indicate that the multi-loss formulation has the greatest impact on synthesis quality among the evaluated design choices, while attention mechanisms, residual connections, and reflection padding provide additional improvements. The main limitation is the size and diversity of the training dataset, which may restrict generalization across geographic regions, seasons, and land-cover types. Although SWIR-cGAN may be applicable to data acquired at different processing levels and spatial resolutions, the experiments reported here and the proposed configuration specifically address WFI–MSI data under the acquisition and processing conditions adopted in this study. Finally, SWIR synthesis should be viewed as a means of augmenting VNIR observations for downstream environmental applications, including burned-area mapping and land-cover change detection, rather than as an end in itself.
blocks.zh: 这封信证明了使用SWIR-cGAN从VNIR数据合成SWIR波段的可行性. 结果表明,合成性能取决于波段,不同的光谱目标得益于结构、感知和对抗目标之间的不同权衡。 多损失配方对被评价的设计选择中的合成质量影响最大,而注意力机制、剩余连接和反射补丁则提供了额外的改进。 主要局限在于培训数据集的规模和多样性,这可能限制跨地理区域、季节和土地覆盖类型的一般化。 虽然SWIR-cGAN可能适用于在不同处理级别和空间分辨率下获得的数据,但这里报告的实验和拟议的配置具体涉及本研究所采用的获取和处理条件下的WFI-MSI数据。 最后,应把SWIR综合视为增加下游环境应用的VNIR观测的手段,包括焚烧区绘图和土地覆盖物变化探测,而不是目的本身。

blocks.en: This framework is relevant to operational monitoring programs such as Deter. Because WFI offers wide-swath coverage (approximately 800 × 800 800\times 800 km) and a high revisit frequency, synthesizing SWIR bands could, for instance, support the detection of degradation caused by fires. In the context of Deter, tests with human analysts could determine whether synthetic SWIR bands improve visual target interpretation alongside automated detection. Future efforts will focus on training SWIR-cGAN on an expanded dataset of WFI–MSI pairs across broader geographic and seasonal conditions to improve generalization to diverse land use and cover classes.
blocks.zh: 这一框架与 " 威慑 " 等业务监测方案相关。 由于WFI提供宽宽覆盖(约800×800800\times 800km)和高复读频率,合成SWIR波段可以支持对火灾引起的退化的探测. 在Deter背景下,与人类分析师的测试可以确定合成SWIR波段是否在自动检测的同时改进视觉目标判读. 今后的努力将侧重于培训SWIR-cGAN,使其掌握在更广泛的地理和季节性条件下扩大的WFI-MSI配对数据集,以改善对多种土地使用和覆盖课程的普及。

blocks.zh: 数据可用性
